mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_execution ( order_request_id, broker_order_no, stock_code, order_side, executed_quantity, executed_price, executed_amount, commission, tax, executed_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{orderRequestId}, #{brokerOrderNo}, #{stockCode}, #{orderSide}, #{executedQuantity}, #{executedPrice}, #{executedAmount}, #{commission}, #{tax}, #{executedAt}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_request_id, broker_order_no, stock_code, order_side, executed_quantity, executed_price, executed_amount, commission, tax, executed_at, created_at FROM order_execution WHERE broker_order_no = #{brokerOrderNo} LIMIT 1
